artifact_assessment.scope: One runnable generated OOP software example; no broad template migration or hardware/intake acceptance.
artifact_assessment.architecture: Reviewed actual main.py, contracts/batch.py, src/features/batch.py, src/container/wiring.py, src/presentation/cli.py and tests/test_contract_batch.py. CLI constructs one immutable typed request and calls BatchService.execute once. AuthenticatedBatchService owns registration/login/processing and finally-based logout; composition root injects the same auth instance into processing and batch services for both backends.
artifact_assessment.behavior_and_tests: Manifest preserves auth/data contracts, implementations and behavior tests byte-for-byte, relocating headless fakes. Shared parametrized fixtures exercise real and mock auth/data/batch behavior. Batch tests check persisted history, authentication failure and session invalidation on success and empty-input failure. CLI tests cover memory execution, SQLite reuse across processes and a declared authentication error. Generator tests cover fresh identities, unapproved lifecycle, preservation of existing work, slug/path restrictions, rewrite drift, foreign working directory invocation, denied-Tk generated suite and a negative presentation boundary import.
artifact_assessment.generation_safety: Explicit 25-copy/16-render manifest contains no approval receipt, keys, runtime database, provider transport or paid pilot. Generator validates plan before creating output, rejects nested/template ancestor destinations and non-empty targets, checks destination/ancestor symlinks and junctions, uses an exclusive lock and exclusive output creation, initializes Git with an empty template and obtains a fresh UUID through B01. Partial output is retained on failure; no rollback claim is made.
artifact_assessment.worker_guidance: Generated AGENTS.md names a single implementation owner and scoped feature/contract/test handoffs. It explicitly states instructions are not filesystem isolation. No worker launch or actual worker read isolation is claimed.

generator_provenance.assessment: The documented historical-generator distinction is sound. Current manifest rendering and literal rewrites independently reproduce all 41 actual artifact file hashes, including application and control files. GENERATION.json remains an honest historical record with template_dirty=true. The supplied final-generator regression evidence and actual-artifact execution evidence are separate; neither establishes that this artifact was generated by the final tool from a clean committed checkout.

verification_limitations: Read-only acceptance: no suites, app commands, generator execution, workers, providers, Docker or Git commands were run. Only standalone standard-library byte hashing/render comparison was executed. The only intentional filesystem write is this report.

No .venv or whole-repository scan. Artifact content review was limited to the requested eight files; byte comparison additionally read only the 41 exact manifest destinations. Source helper/auth/data/fake and shared-test reads were limited to exact manifest paths.

Fresh independent Git initialization and UUID/lifecycle behavior are supported by inspected generator/B01 code, focused tests and supplied logs. Repository history/remotes and host authority records were not independently inspected.

The claimed lint-only nature of the historical generator change is supplied context; no historical source diff was independently reconstructed. Historical and current generator raw hashes are both recorded.

No dedicated destination-link regression appears in the reviewed generator test file; linked-target refusal is established here by static code inspection, not a newly executed negative test. Concurrent hostile filesystem replacement is not independently tested or certified.
Preservation of pre-existing root application/contracts is supported by generator scope and manifest reuse; a complete before/after checkout preservation audit was not performed.
Existing numerical/username/demo defects, broad software/hardware intake, general worker isolation and deployment are intentionally outside B02.
